title: TypePDF marking (v1)
description: A marking of a paper answered in TypePDF and exported with Export for AI. Import it in TypePDF (Marks → Import marking) to see it drawn on the paper like a teacher's red pen. Name the file "<paper title> - marking.json".

paperId.description: The export's paperId. If it doesn't match the open paper TypePDF warns but still imports.

exported.description: The export's exported timestamp: the export this marking is for.

score.description: Marks awarded, excluded parts left out. Defaults to the sum of the parts.

outOf.description: Marks available, excluded parts left out. Defaults to the sum of the parts.

id.description: The answer's id from the export (e.g. "3a-iii", "4a-gap3", "5d-drawn"). An unknown id is reported and skipped.

q.description: The part label, e.g. "3(a)(iii)". Used if the id isn't found.

verdict.description: excluded: skipped on purpose, shown grey and left out of the total.

correction.description: The model answer or fix, shown under the comment as "Answer: …".

type.description: Ticks are green, everything else red (never blue).

match.description: Words copied from the typed answer. Not found: placed beside the whole answer.

oneOf.description: 0–1 of that part's image in the workings PDF (top left is 0,0).

text.description: A short label, e.g. "should be 8". Up to about 28 characters is written beside the mark; longer goes in the margin.
